localidad: Cesar, Manaure, Serranía del Perijá, arriba de El Cinco
comentarios: Perija 142. The long song of *saltuensis* is the descending trill in the center of the cut; natural vocalization. Check out this paper by López-O. et al. 2014 in Ornitología Colombiana 14: 62–93: [The birds of Serranía de Perijá: The northernmost avifauna of the Andes](http://asociacioncolombianadeornitologia.org/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/MS1223.pdf) and [photo album](https://www.flickr.com/photos/amcuervo/sets/72157648905991251/)
